hints.title: Sort Lexicographically
hints.text: Sorting paths lexicographically guarantees that any parent folder appears immediately prior to its subfolders.

hints.title: Check Subfolder Prefix Condition
hints.text: A path f is a subfolder of last_folder if f starts with last_folder concatenated with a forward slash.

hints.title: Append Independent Folders
hints.text: If f does not start with last_folder slash, append f to results and update last_folder to f.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: L: maximum length of a folder string
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing all pairs of folders takes O(N^2 * L) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting the paths groups descendants consecutively, enabling a single linear filtering pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should check the trailing slash delimiter to avoid prefix confusion like /a and /ab.
complexity.notes: Folder paths always start with a slash and contain no trailing slashes.
